purpose.background: EXAMPLE CONTENT — replace with the real reason for this request. The REV3 assembly entombs the PCBs in epoxy, which changes how heat leaves the boards. Bench DVT confirms function at room temperature; we have not yet looked at how much thermal headroom the full assembly has under sustained load.
objectives: Does the assembled controller run at full rated load for an extended period without derating, faults, or resets?
Where are the hottest points on the assembly, and how close are they to component limits?
Does the epoxy entombment change thermal behavior enough to matter versus the previous revision?

approach: Treat this as characterization first, pass/fail second — I want to understand the thermal picture, not just get a green check.

Run the assembly at full rated load until temperatures stabilize, then push ambient up in steps toward the rated maximum. A prior-revision unit run side-by-side would make a useful baseline if one is available.
Stop at the rated maximum ambient; this is not a test-to-failure.

envisionedTests.name: Sustained full-load run
envisionedTests.learn: Whether the controller holds full output continuously at room ambient.
envisionedTests.pass: Runs the full duration with no faults, resets, or output derating.
envisionedTests.fail: Any unexpected fault, reset, or drop in output.

envisionedTests.name: Hot-spot survey
envisionedTests.learn: Where heat concentrates on the assembly and how much margin each hot spot has.
envisionedTests.pass: All measured points stay comfortably below component ratings.
envisionedTests.fail: Any point at or near a component rating, or a hot spot we didn't expect.

envisionedTests.name: Elevated-ambient step-up
envisionedTests.learn: How behavior changes as ambient approaches the rated maximum.
envisionedTests.pass: Full function at rated max ambient; temperatures rise predictably.
envisionedTests.fail: Faults, derating, or runaway temperature before rated max ambient.

successCriteria.pass: Every envisioned test passes and the lab can identify the top hot spots with margin to spare. We can release REV3 without thermal changes.
successCriteria.fail: Any fault/derating at or below rated conditions, or any component at its limit. Design change needed before release.
successCriteria.inconclusive: Results pass but margin is thin or measurements are noisy — need more units or a refined setup.

constraints: Do not open the enclosure or remove epoxy.
Do not exceed the rated maximum ambient temperature.
Please send back raw temperature logs and photos of probe placement.
